exposure: oxytocin receptor genotype at rs53576 (A-carriers vs. GG)
outcome: blood loss of 1000 mL or greater
need for at least one second-line uterotonic treatment
cohort: 119 postpartum participants who underwent vaginal birth at or after 37 weeks of gestation.
finding: A-carriers of the oxytocin receptor genotype at rs53576 had significantly higher blood loss (275.2 mL) and a 79% higher risk for needing at least one second-line uterotonic treatment for postpartum hemorrhage compared to GG carriers.
